metadata.description: A curated collection of plugins for Claude Code and Tanzu Platform

plugins.name: supplychain-motivator
plugins.description: Motivate the supply chain team based on daily target. Checks daily output and generates encouragement or celebration messages.

plugins.name: factory-audit
plugins.description: Audit factory applications for memory compliance in org dekt-org-group. Flags apps over 1GB and recommends reducing memory.

plugins.name: google-chat-poster
plugins.description: Post messages to Google Chat Spaces. Aggregates results from all other skills in multi-task prompts into a single formatted message.

plugins.name: mailgun
plugins.description: Send emails via Mailgun API. Use when the user requests to send an email, notify someone via email, or compose and deliver email messages to recipients.
